independentUnits: one distinct project repository; its positive and negative query form one cluster, not two independent samples
clusterInterpretation: Distinct sourceRef grouping only; it does not establish independent statistical sampling.
searchTargetRecallAt100Semantics: LEGACY strict equality: matching source, heading and exact labeled start/end lines; use the explicit searchExactLabeledRangeAt100 or searchTargetRangeContainedAt100 fields.
searchRangeMetricNote: Range containment requires the same sourceRef and inclusive candidate line bounds that fully contain the labeled range. The heading-constrained variant additionally requires a matching heading/path. These are retrieval coverage metrics, not semantic sufficiency; review fetched text independently.

answerabilityMetrics.decisionAccuracyNote: This is answerability-status accuracy (select when answerable, abstain when unanswerable); exact/relevant/outside-labeled range quality is separate. Failures/unknown decisions are reported separately; raw Jev scores remain descriptive and uncalibrated.

rangeSelectionMetrics.note: A range outside the exact or explicitly labeled relevant ranges is ungraded for semantic usefulness; it is not automatically irrelevant. Inspect source text and blinded review separately.

limitations: Observed 1 distinct sourceRef cluster(s); this grouping is descriptive and does not establish statistical independence.
Label/adjudication status: Reviewers independently read the exact frozen README and queries before any live call; labels are file-scoped, not repository-owner gold..
Raw Choice confidence and evidence sufficiency are descriptive; this runner makes no calibration claim.
